text: #803, built by hand because CI's integration shard failed on every pull request: the plumbing sandbox pins Alpine's git 2.54.1-r0 in place of 2.54.0-r0, which Alpine 3.24 no longer serves, so the image builds again; bash stays 5.3.9-r1. Alpine keeps one version of each package in a branch, so an exact pin breaks whenever a patch release lands, and the fix is to bump the pin to the version served. A patch-level bump Alpine forces needs no real-image budget check (D-0390): it changes no limit, toolchain, interpreter or test workload.
